Helpful details to include, if you know them

• What happened?
• When and where did it happen?
• Who was involved?
• Were there witnesses or supporting evidence?
• What would you like the PCA to know?

Your messages and conversation are sent to Google Gemini to generate replies. On the free tier, Google may use submitted content to improve its products. Avoid names, ID numbers, phone numbers, addresses, or other identifying details. Replies are not official PCA decisions or legal advice.
